body.usage: Data Tables, Body Text, Labels, Inputs

mono.usage: Code Snippets, IDs, Logs, Technical Data

colors.rules: No gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors. Gradients only for subtle active states or 'Tracing Beam' borders.

layout.spacing: Compact for data density (p-4, gap-4). Relaxed for containers (p-6).

cards.style: Flat, 1px border, no shadow (Dark Mode) / Subtle shadow-sm (Light Mode).

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.

tables.style: Dense, row hover effects, sticky header.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for Topbar and Toast notifications only.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on sidebar background.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-muted/50). Button press scale (active:scale-95).

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THEME TOGGLE IMMEDIATELY: Wrap the app in a ThemeProvider.
USE SHADCN COMPONENTS: Do not build custom UI from scratch unless necessary.
DENSITY IS KEY: This is an admin tool. Avoid excessive whitespace in data tables.
CHARTS: Use Recharts for all data visualization.
NAVIGATION: Implement the sidebar with collapsible functionality.
MOCK DATA: Generate realistic mock data for M365 reports (Exchange, Entra ID).
AUTHENTICATION: Build a professional Login page with the provided background image.
universal_guidelines: DO NOT apply universal transition: * { transition: all ... }
DO NOT center align the app container.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use semantic HTML (nav, main, aside, section).
